description: Synthetic, made up for a test. Request 0 to 199. The pinned genesis is the FLOP devnet genesis (DEVNET_GENESIS in src/status.ts); every event and block hash is made up. Clause numbers refer to RULES.md section 3.1. For blocks 0 to 99, page 0 ends the walk (next_page null), and two copies of page 7, which the walk never reaches, disagree on next_page (null and 8). That breaks the chain whether or not the walk reaches page 7 (clause 2), so blocks 0 to 99 are a gap and the open on page 0 counts nowhere. Blocks 100 to 199 have a complete chain with one release, which counts. Expected: complete false, status partial; covered 100 to 199; gaps 0 to 99; totals escrows_opened 0, escrows_released 1, escrows_refunded 0, channels_opened 0, channels_settled 0; pending_unfinalized 0; duplicates_dropped 0; excluded_other_genesis 0; malformed_dropped 0; by_account synthetic-alice (escrows_released 1).
